title: 7 遭遇虚灵虎8 突破9 逃走
content_zh:
等到吴邪走后，负责人才心有余悸的捂着胸口深呼吸了一口气。
同时负责人也在暗自怀疑，那个接了多个试炼任务的修士到底是谁，值得城主这么心思隆重的过问。
正常情况下，城主根本就不关心试炼的事情，负责人也想不通那个陌生修士到底有什么问题。
“早知道就应该听那个老鬼的话拿下那个陌生修士了。“
负责人捶胸顿足，有些后悔不已。
如果他之前相信中年男修士老鬼的话，这样就知道为什么城主要那么关注那个陌生修士了，只是可惜的是已经迟了……
吴邪知道洛豪前往了横断山脉的消息，也是飞快的往横断山脉赶过去。
吴邪之所以这么关注洛豪，是因为他和向天关系要好，虽然向天没有调查到洛豪的下落，但是向天早就查到了向阳是死在了洛豪的手里。
所以向天拜托吴邪一定要好好关注来横断城的陌生修士，尤其是实力比较突出的修士，因为很有可能是杀害了向阳的凶手。
虽然吴邪不确定这个接了多个任务的修士是不是洛豪，但是吴邪宁愿错杀一千，也不会放过一个。
既然有这样的陌生修士来了，那就要好好调查一番。
如果是杀害向阳的凶手，那正好拿下他，交给向天，让向天欠自己一个人情，也是极好的，这就是吴邪心里的想法。
吴邪的速度非常之快，十分钟左右就赶到了横断山脉山脚下。
当他来到山脚下的时候，皱了皱眉，因为此时山脚下已经没有任何试炼的修士了。
一旦修士进入了山脉里面，那要想找一个人就太困难了。
不过这也确实难不倒吴邪，只见吴邪掏出一个灵珠，这上面竟然出现了洛豪进入横断山脉里面的图像。
原来横断山脉外围有监控阵法，而吴邪掏出的灵珠就是一个查看监控阵法的水晶球，当然，这个水晶球也只能监控到横断山脉得外围，具体里面的方向，那就得靠吴邪自己了。
不过吴邪很清楚洛豪进入的森林前往的方向也就那么几个方向，所以哪怕全部都跑一遍，吴邪也有自信可以追上洛豪。
知道了洛豪进入横断山脉的方向之后，吴邪径直往洛豪进入横断山脉的方向遁去。
如果吴邪不这么自大的话，那还可以追到洛豪。

洛豪使用神识遁遁行了一段距离之后，发现自己的神识范围又开始慢慢扩散，因为使用神识遁消耗了太多神识，所以洛豪需要丹药补充神识，好在他在森林里采摘了不少可以恢复神识的神灵草。
只是可惜洛豪现在没有丹炉，不然洛豪都想自己炼制神灵丹，吃下神灵草的效果是远远不如神灵丹的效果的。
洛豪心里也是很震惊的，横断山脉太多的灵草了，洛豪甚至都想把整座横断山脉的所有灵草都给搬到混沌书中去，只是那不太现实。
第一混沌书目前还没有形成混沌世界，第二洛豪要是搬走横断山脉，那不成了整个横断山脉修士甚至有可能是中洲修士的公敌了。
对于中洲，洛豪从王小霜给的玉简哪里也得知了很多信息，横断山脉还只是中洲最外围的边缘山脉，这里面修为最高的也有筑鼎修士了。
筑鼎修士一出现，以洛豪现在的实力，根本就没法逃走。
筑鼎修士甚至只需要一个眼神就可以秒杀他，更何况中洲内地大陆甚至还有修真界最高境界化仙实力的修士。
所以洛豪是断然不敢搬走横断山脉的。
不过这么多的灵草，洛豪可不想放过，所以现在洛豪的混沌书中有不少的灵草，神灵草也不在少数，用一点神灵草也没什么。
补充了神识之后，洛豪就发现整个人神清气爽了一番，然后神识的范围开始扩大，速度也比之前更快了。
洛豪甚至自信，就算有成丹实力的修士也不一定能够追的上他。
直到吃了十株神灵草，洛豪发现自己的神识范围扩充到一千米的时候，就发现神灵草的作用没有那么大了，自己的神识也扩散到了极限，洛豪就知道还是自己的修为太低了，所以洛豪此时迫切的需要找一个地方闭关，然后提升自己的实力。
又行了一阵，洛豪终于来到了一条小溪边，小溪的对面居然有一棵高约四丈高的草丹树，而草丹树上还有二十颗已经成熟的闪闪发亮的草丹果。
草丹果可是成丹期修炼所用的灵果啊，洛豪确实震惊了，没想到居然还能在这里看到成丹期所修炼的草丹果。
草丹果还可以炼制成草灵丹，草灵丹可以足足提升成丹修士一个阶段的实力了，假如他现在是成丹初期实力，那吃下一枚草灵丹，妥妥的成丹中期实力。
就算是没有炼制成草灵丹的草丹果也可以让成丹初期实力的修士突破到成丹初期巅峰了。
至于成丹期以下，那吃上一颗草丹果，洛豪已经可以肯定他的修为能立刻变成结真后期了。
content_en:
After Wu Xie left, the person in charge held his chest and took a deep breath with lingering fear.
At the same time, the person in charge was also secretly doubting who the monk who had taken on multiple trial tasks was, worthy of the city lord's thoughtful and solemn questioning.
Under normal circumstances, the city lord didn't care about the trial at all, and the person in charge couldn't figure out what the problem was with the strange monk.
"If I had known earlier, I should have listened to that old ghost and captured that strange monk."
The person in charge beat his chest and felt a little regretful.
If he had believed the old ghost, a middle-aged male monk, then he would know why the city lord paid so much attention to the strange monk, but unfortunately it was already too late...
Wu Xie knew that Luo Hao had gone to the Hengduan Mountains, so he quickly rushed there.
The reason why Wu Xie paid so much attention to Luo Hao was because he had a good relationship with Xiang Tian. Although Xiang Tian did not investigate Luo Hao's whereabouts, Xiang Tian had already found out that Xiang Yang died in Luo Hao's hands.
Therefore, Xiangtian asked Wu Xie to pay close attention to the strange monks who came to Hengduan City, especially the monks with outstanding strength, because they might be the murderers of Xiangyang.
Although Wu Xie was not sure whether this monk who had taken on multiple tasks was Luo Hao, Wu Xie would rather kill a thousand by mistake than let one go.
Since such a strange monk has come, we must investigate carefully.
If he was the murderer of Xiang Yang, it would be great to capture him and hand him over to Xiang Tian so that Xiang Tian could owe him a favor. This was what Wu Xie was thinking.
Wu Xie was very fast and arrived at the foot of the Hengduan Mountains in about ten minutes.
When he came to the foot of the mountain, he frowned, because there were no trial monks at the foot of the mountain at this time.
Once a monk enters the mountains, it will be too difficult to find someone.
However, this was indeed not a problem for Wu Xie. Wu Xie took out a spirit bead, and an image of Luo Hao entering the Hengduan Mountains actually appeared on it.
It turns out that there is a monitoring formation outside the Hengduan Mountains, and the spirit bead Wu Xie took out was a crystal ball for viewing the monitoring formation. Of course, this crystal ball can only monitor the outside of the Hengduan Mountains. The specific direction inside depends on Wu Xie himself.
However, Wu Xie knew very well that the forest Luo Hao entered could only go in a few directions, so even if he ran through them all, Wu Xie was confident that he could catch up with Luo Hao.
After knowing the direction from which Luo Hao entered the Hengduan Mountains, Wu Xie fled directly in the direction from which Luo Hao entered the Hengduan Mountains.
If Wu Xie wasn't so arrogant, he could still catch Luo Hao.
After Luo Hao used Divine Sense to escape for a certain distance, he found that the range of his Divine Sense began to slowly expand again. Because using Divine Sense to Escape consumed too much of his Divine Sense, Luo Hao needed elixirs to replenish his Divine Sense. Fortunately, he picked a lot of divine grass in the forest that could restore his Divine Sense.
It's a pity that Luo Hao doesn't have an alchemy furnace now, otherwise Luo Hao would want to refine the divine elixir by himself, and the effect of eating the divine elixir would be far inferior to that of the divine elixir.
Luo Hao was also shocked. There were too many spiritual herbs in the Hengduan Mountains. Luo Hao even wanted to move all the spiritual herbs in the entire Hengduan Mountains to the Book of Chaos, but that was not realistic.
First, the Chaos Book has not yet formed a chaotic world. Second, if Luo Hao moves away from the Hengduan Mountains, he will become the public enemy of the entire Hengduan Mountains monks and may even be the public enemy of the Central Continent monks.
Regarding Central Continent, Luo Hao also learned a lot of information from the jade slips given by Wang Xiaoshuang. The Hengduan Mountains are only the outermost edge mountains of Central Continent, and the highest cultivation among them are also the tripod-building monks.
As soon as the tripod-building monk appeared, Luo Hao couldn't escape at all with his current strength.
The Ding-building cultivator can kill him instantly with just one look, not to mention that there are even cultivators in the mainland of Central Continent who have the highest level of immortality in the world of cultivation.
So Luo Hao is cut offHowever, I dare not move away from the Hengduan Mountains.
However, Luo Hao doesn't want to let go of so many spiritual herbs, so now Luo Hao's book of chaos contains a lot of spiritual herbs, and there are also many divine herbs. It doesn't matter if you use a little divine grass.
After replenishing his spiritual consciousness, Luo Hao found that his whole body felt refreshed, and then the range of his spiritual consciousness began to expand faster than before.
Luo Hao was even confident that even a monk with Chengdan strength might not be able to catch up with him.
After eating ten plants of the divine grass, Luo Hao found that the range of his spiritual consciousness had expanded to one thousand meters. He found that the effect of the divine grass was not that great, and his spiritual consciousness had also spread to the limit. Luo Hao knew that his cultivation level was too low, so Luo Hao urgently needed to find a place to retreat and improve his strength.
After walking for a while, Luo Hao finally came to a small stream. On the opposite side of the stream, there was a Cao Dan tree about four feet high, and there were twenty ripe and shiny Cao Dan fruits on the Cao Dan tree.
The grass elixir fruit is a spiritual fruit used in the cultivation of the elixir. Luo Hao was really shocked. He didn't expect to see the elixir fruit cultivated in the elixir here.
The grass pill fruit can also be refined into a grass spirit pill. The grass spirit pill can fully improve the strength of the pill monk by one stage. If he is now at the early stage of pill cultivation, then eating a grass spirit pill will fully increase his mid-stage pill cultivation strength.
Even if the grass elixir fruit has not been refined into the grass spirit elixir, it can allow monks with early-stage elixir-formation strength to break through to the peak of the early-stage elixir.
As for those below the attainment stage, after eating a grass pill fruit, Luo Hao can be sure that his cultivation will immediately reach the stage of attainment.
